bank.calibration_source: CMF, Informe del Desempeno del Sistema Bancario y Cooperativas, agosto 2026 (published 2026-09-29), Cuadro N 1 column Bancos, https://www.cmfchile.cl/portal/estadisticas/617/articles-113863_recurso_1.pdf, sha256 5116240cb2ed92d37048defe70ab4c5dd6b6680ef0ecb2b6b2c7912fed71329e; the three loan portfolios are the C07 targets; securities, deposits, equity and loans to banks are the other figures of the same table; scaled to the C07 total exposure; the UF shares, profiles, deposit split and behaviour are synthetic

notice.en: Banco Andino is a synthetic bank. Its balance-sheet aggregates are calibrated to the CMF system aggregates of August 2026; the UF share, the repricing profile of each item, the deposit split and every behavioural assumption are synthetic and stated in the document. The curves are real: the Banco Central de Chile F022 yields of the valuation date.
notice.es: Banco Andino es un banco sintético. Los agregados de su balance están calibrados a los agregados del sistema de la CMF de agosto de 2026; la proporción en UF, el perfil de reprecio de cada partida, la separación de depósitos y todo supuesto de comportamiento son sintéticos y están declarados en el documento. Las curvas son reales: los rendimientos F022 del Banco Central de Chile de la fecha de valoración.

ur_currency.label: UR

definition.en: All CLP-indexed (UF) flows are treated as one currency, UR (RAN 21-13 Annex 1).
definition.es: Todos los flujos reajustables (UF) se tratan como una sola moneda, UR (RAN 21-13 Anexo 1).

ur_currency.uf_source: Banco Central de Chile, BDE series F073.UFF.PRE.Z.D (Unidad de fomento), value of 2026-09-03

clp.source: Banco Central de Chile, BDE table F022, secondary-market yields of Central Bank and Treasury bonds, pesos (CLP), tenors 2, 5, 10 years, observation date 2026-09-03. The yields are read as semiannual bond-equivalent par yields and bootstrapped to continuously compounded zero rates with riskvalidation.irrbb.curves.bootstrap_zero_curve (frequency 2, simple interest up to six months, par yields interpolated linearly between pillars); one Nelson-Siegel curve is then fitted to the zero rates with fit_nelson_siegel (least squares for beta0, beta1 and beta2 on a tau grid of 0.25 to 10 years in steps of 0.25) and evaluated at the 19 bucket midpoints with nelson_siegel_yield. The BCCh publishes 3 pesos tenors and the engine's fit needs four points, so the monetary policy rate (F022.TPM.TIN.D001.NO.Z.D), the Central Bank's overnight rate, is the fourth point at 1/360 year: a policy rate, not a secondary-market yield (a Contraste choice, stated as an open question).
clp.attribution: Source: Banco Central de Chile (BDE), series F022.BCLP.TIS.AN02.NO.Z.D, F022.BCLP.TIS.AN05.NO.Z.D, F022.BCLP.TIS.AN10.NO.Z.D, F022.TPM.TIN.D001.NO.Z.D. The fitted zero curve is an adaptation by Contraste of the Banco Central de Chile's data and is its sole responsibility (BCCh terms).

ur.source: Banco Central de Chile, BDE table F022, secondary-market yields of Central Bank and Treasury bonds, UF-indexed (UR), tenors 2, 5, 10, 30 years, observation date 2026-09-03. The yields are read as semiannual bond-equivalent par yields and bootstrapped to continuously compounded zero rates with riskvalidation.irrbb.curves.bootstrap_zero_curve (frequency 2, simple interest up to six months, par yields interpolated linearly between pillars); one Nelson-Siegel curve is then fitted to the zero rates with fit_nelson_siegel (least squares for beta0, beta1 and beta2 on a tau grid of 0.25 to 10 years in steps of 0.25) and evaluated at the 19 bucket midpoints with nelson_siegel_yield.

description.en: Constant balance sheet: maturing and repricing flows are replaced by identical new ones. The UR leg carries the real rate only (balances in CLP million at the UF value); the indexation income is outside it.
description.es: Balance constante: los flujos que vencen o reprecian se reemplazan por otros idénticos. El tramo UR lleva solo la tasa real (saldos en millones de CLP al valor de la UF); el ingreso por reajuste queda fuera.

rule.en: Post-shock rates are floored at -2 percent for UR and at 0 percent for CLP (RAN 21-13 Annex 1); the engine's apply_floor also keeps a rate that is already below its floor at its pre-shock value, a reading that is UNVERIFIED for the UR floor. The smallest distance between a post-shock rate and its floor is 20.48 bp (UR, delta NII, parallel-down); the floors bind in 0 shock and leg combinations.
rule.es: Las tasas posteriores al choque tienen piso de -2 por ciento para la UR y 0 por ciento para el CLP (RAN 21-13 Anexo 1); apply_floor del motor también mantiene en su valor previo una tasa que ya está bajo su piso, lectura que no está verificada para el piso UR. La menor distancia entre una tasa posterior al choque y su piso es 20,48 pb (UR, delta NII, parallel-down); los pisos actúan en 0 combinaciónes de choque y tramo.

rule.en: When delta CLP and delta CLF have opposite signs, half of the CLP is offset against the CLF (or the reverse), floored at zero.
rule.es: Si los deltas CLP y CLF tienen signos opuestos, se compensa la mitad del CLP contra el CLF (o al revés), con piso en cero.

indexation_charge.formula: charge = 0.025 x |PN_UR|, PN_UR = net UF position x UF value

note.en: The standardised indexation (reajustabilidad) charge, an implied 2.5 percent inflation surprise on the net UF position, added once to the largest pair of the delta NII.
note.es: El cargo estándar por reajustabilidad, equivalente a una sorpresa de inflación de 2,5 por ciento sobre la posición neta en UF, se suma una vez al mayor par del delta NII.

label.en: Delta NII with the indexation charge
label.es: Delta NII con el cargo por reajustabilidad

title.en: Delta EVE is 17.1 percent of Tier 1 (threshold 15 percent) and delta NII with the indexation charge is 0.8 percent (threshold 5 percent); the bank is prioritised under the Annex 1 tests.
title.es: El delta EVE es 17,1 por ciento del Tier 1 (umbral 15 por ciento) y el delta NII con el cargo por reajustabilidad es 0,8 por ciento (umbral 5 por ciento); el banco es priorizado según los tests del Anexo 1.

title.en: The standard indexation charge is 15 percent of the delta NII: it depends on the size of the net UF position, not on the rate shock, and no hedge is modelled.
title.es: El cargo estándar por reajustabilidad es 15 por ciento del delta NII: depende del tamaño de la posición neta en UF y no del choque de tasas, y no se modela ninguna cobertura.

title.en: No post-shock floor binds on the curves of the valuation date: the smallest distance to a floor is 20.5 bp (UR, delta NII, parallel-down); the floors would matter only at lower rates.
title.es: Ningún piso posterior al choque actúa sobre las curvas de la fecha de valoración: la menor distancia a un piso es 20,5 pb (UR, delta NII, parallel-down); los pisos importarían solo con tasas más bajas.

title.en: The pesos curve has three published tenors and the engine's Nelson-Siegel fit needs four: the monetary policy rate is its overnight point, a policy rate and not a secondary-market yield.
title.es: La curva en pesos tiene tres plazos publicados y el ajuste Nelson-Siegel del motor necesita cuatro: la tasa de política monetaria es su punto a un día, una tasa de política y no un rendimiento de mercado secundario.
